scope: scripts/qualify_hardware_changes.py on a frozen Debug build of b8885c6c (artifacts/hf6, git archive), 460/460 steps, in an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 with an added CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1, a CPU 1214C DC/DC/DC V4.7, an ET 200MP IM 155-5 PN ST V4.1 station and an ET 200SP IM 155-6 PN ST V6.4 station on one subnet: the S7-1500, S7-1200 and ET 200MP family gates of local.hardware_changes.families.20261029; ET 200SP on the second CPU (assignment with the generated server module moved to slot 4, two catalog-selected DI 8x24VDC ST plugged, attributes, replacement 6ES7 131-6BF00-0BA0 V1.1 to 6ES7 131-6BF01-0BA0 V0.0, delete, restore); a shared device in one project (connector 1 joins a new IO system of the scratch CPU with SpDi3 assigned to it through SharedDeviceAssignmentTarget); hardware_shared_device_access (SpDi4 OutsideOfProject with one external IO controller, back to PLC on the second CPU restored); an MRP ring (domain HwRing created with the scratch CPU as manager, the second CPU and the IM 155-5 PN ST as clients, the first client's join and the ring closure restored, ManagerAuto restored after the reopen); an address-changing replacement (DI 16x24VDC HF to DI 32x24VDC HF 6ES7 521-1BL00-0AB0 V2.2 refused until the referencing tag was acknowledged, applied with its address map and tag impact, restored); module capability profiles of 13 types; every change with asserted preview, checkpoint, device compile and save, exact state deltas, fresh-Portal reopen and checkpoint restore; typed refusals change nothing; no GSD device installed (gsdNotInstalled).
limitations: In-project shared device: one IO device shared by two CPUs of one project, one submodule assigned to the second; the sharedDevice disconnect is not exercised.
hardware_shared_device_access: OutsideOfProject (with NumberOfExternalIoControllers 1) and PLC back to the second CPU on one ET 200SP DI module; no second project.
MRP: one ring of three members in one created domain; ring ports are the interfaces' Port_1/Port_2; no MRP telegrams, domain attributes or MRP interconnection.
Address-changing replacement: the replaced module's input range grows (start kept); a moved start is not exercised; tag addresses are not rewritten.
Capability profiles are observations of the created types in this run's configuration; plug rules at slots 1-4 of each rack type in the final configuration.
No GSD device: V21 Openness has no GSD installation API and no operator-installed GSD was present (gsdNotInstalled).
Engineering only; nothing is downloaded and no physical topology is observed.
